text_blocks.snippet: The fastest way to recover from COVID-19 symptoms depends on the severity of the illness. For mild cases, rest, hydration, and over-the-counter medications like acetaminophen or ibuprofen can help manage symptoms. For those at higher risk, early treatment with medications like Paxlovid is crucial and must be started within 5-7 days of symptom onset to be effective, according to the CDC.

The drug is imported and marketed by the pharma companies Roche India and Cipla
Each patient dose is 1200 mg (600 mg of Casirivimab and 600 mg of Imdevimab)
The drugs are a combination of monoclonal or artificial antibody made by cloning a unique white blood cell
These antibodies are designed to fight against the spike protein of SARS-CoV-2
The therapy is effective for the treatment of COVID-19 patients with mild to moderate symptoms
The drug is given during the first seven days of the infection when the virus multiplies
The therapy is not advised for severe Covid-19 patients who require oxygen therapy
